（こんな仰々しい部屋につれてかれて……\n俺はいったいどうなるんだ……）: (Brought to a room as grand as this... What on earth is going to happen to me...?)
（あの人が連れて行かれて、\n中の様子もわからない……大丈夫でしょうか……？）: (He was taken inside, and we can't tell what's going on... Will he be alright...?)
それで、結局どういう理由でわたくしたちを連行したのですか？: So, for what reason were we detained?
タツミヤ鉱に関するトラブル……といえばわかりますね？: Trouble regarding Tatsumiya Ore... That should be enough for you to understand, right?
鉱石に関する権利で揉めたんだよね？\nカオスメイデンからの連絡もあって、風紀委員: You got into a dispute over the rights to the ore, right? We also received a report from Chaos Maiden, so the Disciplinary Committee took charge of the situation.
あれは境界線上ですわ！\nＭＧのログを確認してくれればわかります！: That was right on the border line! If you check the MG logs, you'll see!
ええ、理解しています。\nあなた方がルール違反を犯したとは思っていません。: Yes, we understand. We don't believe that you committed any rule violations.
ですが、揉めたという報告があった以上は、\n我々も動いて確認を取らざるを得ません: However, as long as there is a report of a dispute, we have no choice but to step in and verify the situation.
今までシリウスシュガーはそういう問題を起こしてないからね。\nそういう意味では信: Sirius Sugar hasn't caused any problems like this until now. In that sense, we do trust you!
でしたら、事情聴取だけでいいのではないですか？\n逮捕だなんて……: If that's the case, shouldn't a simple questioning be enough? Calling it an arrest is a bit much...
でもさ、君たちが持ち帰ったのは鉱石だけじゃないでしょ？: But you girls didn't just bring back ore, right?
素性の知れない人物を連れ帰ってきたのは、\n大変な問題です。そのことは理解されて: Bringing back a person of unknown origin is a very serious issue. Surely you understand that much?
外部からの違法な侵入者っていう可能性だってあるよね？: Isn't there a possibility he could be an illegal intruder from the outside?
それはそう、ですけども……: This place is an academy, but it's also the world's most important resource mining base! So if a terrorist managed to slip in... you get it, right?
彼を保護した直後にメイズシフターとの交戦状態になったんだよね。\nだから、こっち: We engaged the Maze Shifters immediately after rescuing him. So we didn't have time to verify anything ourselves, either.
それに、彼は機体も武器も持っていない……全裸の状態だった。\nそれでテロリストを: Besides, he had no unit or weapons... He was completely butt-naked. Isn't it a bit of a stretch to suspect him of being a terrorist like that?
そーそー、もしかしたらラミたちが知らないだけで、\n学園の生徒の可能性もあったし: Yeah, yeah! Maybe we just didn't know him, and there was a chance he was a student here～
ぜ、全裸ぁ！？\n……だったらその場で判断できないのは仕方ないかもね。: B-Butt-naked!? ...Well, then it might be understandable that you couldn't make a judgment on the spot.
わざと隠してたわけじゃない。: It's not like we were hiding him on purpose.
貴方がたの言い分は分かりました……が、\n最終的な判断は生徒会長が致します。: I understand your side of the story... however, the final judgment will be made by the Student Council President.
……なるほど。彼を取り調べしてるってわけだね。\nその結果次第で、あたしたちの処: ...I see. So she's interrogating him right now. And our fate will be decided based on the outcome.
今はまだなにも言えません。\n生徒会長の判断になりますから。: I can't say anything right now. It all depends on the Student Council President's decision.
とはいえ、記憶喪失なのが嘘だったり変なことを言ってたら……\n学園を追放か、それ: Though, if his amnesia turns out to be a lie or if he says strange things... He might be expelled from the academy, or even imprisoned.
取り調べの結果によっては、\nそれ以上に悪い結末もありえますね。: Depending on the results of the interrogation, an even worse outcome is possible.
あなたが通報のあった侵入者……ですね。: You must be the intruder reported to us...
――では、まずは私から名乗りましょう。\n私はこの学園の生徒会長を務める『四王天: —Allow me to introduce myself first. I am Shiouten Kagura, the Student Council President of this academy.
ええ、このザルトゥーム学園の全権を任されております。: Yes, I have been entrusted with full authority over Zartum Academy.
つまり……あなたがこの学園の最高権力者ってわけか。: So in other words... you're the highest authority at this school.
そのように受け取っていただいて結構です。: You may interpret it that way.
では、話を戻しましょうか。\nつまり、あなたは記憶喪失で何も憶えていないと。: Now then, shall we return to the topic at hand? In short, you claim to have amnesia and remember nothing.
ああ。他でも何度も説明はしているんだが……その通りだ。: Yeah. I've explained it several times to others, but... that's right.
しつこく聞いてしまって申し訳ありません。\nですが、これも必要な事ですので。: I apologize for pressing the issue repeatedly. However, this is necessary.
あなたほどの立場がある人が文字通り、\n裸一貫で倒れてた俺を直々に尋問するのはな: Why would someone in your position personally interrogate a guy who was found literally butt-naked?
あなたという存在にそれだけ謎が多いからです。: Because there are far too many mysteries surrounding your existence.
シリウスシュガーの全機体のデータ……それ以外の情報も集めました。\nそれでも、あ: I have gathered data on all of Sirius Sugar's units... as well as other information. Even so, the cause and reason for your presence inside the Maze remain unknown.
男性でありながらメイズに潜れる人間はとても珍しいのです。\nその素質を持つ者の多: A male who can dive into the Maze is exceedingly rare. The vast majority of those with that aptitude are female.
しかし、そんな人物の情報がどこからも一切出てこない……: Yet, no information regarding such a person exists anywhere...
唯一わかるのはメイズ内部で発見され、記憶喪失だということ。\nこれを謎と言わずし: The only facts we know are that you were found in the Maze and have amnesia. If that is not a mystery, what else could it be called?
ですから、私自身が直接判断をするべきだと話を伺いにきました。: That is why I came to speak with you directly, to make a judgment myself.
そうなると、俺はどうなるんだ？: So, what's going to happen to me then?
記憶喪失であるあなたが危険な存在だと分かれば、\n学園から追放して、しかるべき組: If I determine that your amnesiac self poses a threat, I intend to expel you from the academy and hand you over to an appropriate organization.
実験施設や、研究所……\n場合によっては牢屋へ収監ということもありえますね。: A research facility, a laboratory... Depending on the circumstances, imprisonment is also a possibility.
それは勘弁してほしいな……\n結局なにもわからないまま朽ち果てそうだ。: Please spare me from that... I'd end up rotting away without ever learning anything.
ですが、なにも思い出せない不審者のあなたを\nこの学園に置いておくのはあまりに危: However, keeping a suspicious person who remembers nothing in this academy is far too dangerous.
思い出せること……なにかないのか……？\nいや、そういえば……: Is there really nothing... nothing I can remember...? Wait, come to think of it...
……ひとつだけ思い出せることがある。: ...There is one thing I can recall.
この世界には滅びの危機が迫っている。: A crisis of destruction is approaching this world.
だから、俺は仲間と共にこの世界を救わないといけないんだ。: That's why I have to save this world together with my comrades.
え……やけにすんなりだな。さっきなんて笑われたぞ。\nあなたは笑ったりしないのか: Huh... That was surprisingly smooth. I was just laughed at earlier. Are you not going to laugh?
別に面白い冗談でもありませんから。\nそれに、記憶喪失のあなたが言う『危機』も気: It isn't a particularly funny joke. Besides, I am curious about this 'crisis' mentioned by an amnesiac.
その記憶喪失の経緯……にも。: As well as the circumstances... behind your amnesia.
メイズで起きた重力異常による記憶障害かもしれませんが……\nあなたが何かメイズに: It might be a memory impairment caused by gravity anomalies in the Maze... but there's also a possibility that you are closely linked to the Maze itself.
それを紐解けば……未だ謎の多いメイズの全容を、\n明らかにすることも可能かもしれ: If we unravel this... it may be possible to reveal the full picture of the Maze, which remains shrouded in mystery.
まだ完全に信用できたわけではありませんが、\nあなたの素性を知るためには保護をす: While I cannot trust you completely just yet, it seems necessary to protect you in order to uncover your identity.
ですが、役に立たない人間をただ保護していても、\n他の生徒に示しがつきません。: However, simply protecting someone of no use would set a poor example for the other students.
ログを確認しましたが、\nどうやらあなたは優れた指揮能力を持っているようですね。: I checked the logs, and it seems you possess outstanding command capabilities.
その実力があれば、未だ底の見えないメイズの、\n未知なる領域まで切り開く事が出来: With that ability, you might be able to carve a path into the unknown reaches of the fathomless Maze.
……そこで、今この場であなたに私の権限で新しい役職を設けます。: ...Therefore, using my authority, I will establish a new position for you right here and now.
生徒会所属、『教導指揮官』です。: Affiliated with the Student Council, 'Instructional Commander'.
わざわざ立場を用意してくれるのはありがたいが……\n他に選択肢はないんだろ？: I appreciate you going out of your way to set up a position for me, but... I don't really have any other options, do I?
ええ。先ほど示したもの以外は。\n研究所送りが良ければ止めは致しません。: Indeed. Aside from what I mentioned earlier. If you prefer being sent to a laboratory, I won't stop you.
これは取引です。あなたの有用性を示してください。\nその限り生徒会はあなたを保護: This is a deal. Prove your usefulness. As long as you do, the Student Council will protect you.
ですが、当然それだけのことをするからにはリスクも背負って貰います。\n……もし有: However, since you are given this opportunity, you must also bear the risk. ...If you fail to prove your usefulness, off to the laboratory you go.
まあ、当然のことだな。役立たずを置いておく理由はないんだろ？: Well, that's only natural. There's no reason to keep someone useless around, right?
その通りです。教導指揮官には生徒会が課した任務遂行において、\n必要な範囲で裁量: Precisely. As Instructional Commander, you will be granted discretion within necessary limits to execute the tasks assigned by the Student Council.
それでどうでしょうか？ 悪い条件ではないと思いますが。: How about it, then? I believe it is not a bad offer.
これからよろしく頼む。: I look forward to working with you.
報酬ではありませんが\n活動と生活に必要なものは生徒会が保障します。: While not a formal salary, the Student Council will provide all necessities for your life and activities.
なら、問題ないな。これからよろしく頼む。: Then there's no problem. I look forward to working with you.
世界が……というのは私の胸の内だけにしまっておきます。\nですから、あなたも口外: I will keep your claim about the world... to myself. Therefore, please do not speak of it to others and focus solely on your mission.
あなたのような存在から発せられるその言葉は\nおそらく不安と恐怖を煽ります。: Words like that coming from someone in your position would likely spread anxiety and fear.
根拠なく、学園内に無用な不安を広げて\n欲しくはありませんので。: I do not want baseless anxiety spreading throughout the academy.
良い返事ですね。\nではこの端末を。: A good answer. Here, take this terminal.
あなた専用の個人端末です。\nここザルトゥーム学園都市における身分証でもあります: It is your personal terminal. It also serves as your ID here in Zartum Academy City.
この都市での生活をサポートするＡＩもついています。: It comes with a built-in AI to assist your daily life in this city.
え？ ああ、ここを押せばいいのか……: Huh? Ah, do I just press here...?
ボクの名前はピコ！ ボクのマスターはあなたですか？\nえーっとパーソナルデータを: My name is Pico! Are you my Master? Umm, let me check your personal data!
ＡＩはそれぞれのパーソナルデータにあわせて、\nその姿を変えます。ですから、この: An AI changes its appearance based on individual personal data. Therefore, this little one will be your dedicated AI.
……パーソナルデータが、ない。\nど、どういうことですか！？: ...Personal data... missing!? W-What is the meaning of this!?
……え、えっと……そうですか！\nいやー、そんなこともありますよね！: ...U-Umm... I see! Ahaha, well, these things happen, right!?
で、でも大丈夫です！ ボクが精一杯、お世話させていただきます！\nもうどんとこい: B-But don't worry! I'll do my absolute best to take care of you! Just leave everything to me!
ああ、迷惑かけると思うがよろしくな。: Yeah, I might be a handful, but I'm counting on you.
では、最初の任務です。\nサポートＡＩに、幾つかのチームのデータを送りました。: Now then, for your first assignment. I have sent data on several teams to your support AI.
むむ！ 届きました！\nえーっと……なんだか冴えない戦績のチームばかりですね。: Mumu! Received! Umm... It seems like these teams all have pretty lackluster track records.
ええ。事実として、成績が悪く伸び悩んでいる者たちです。\nあなたがチームを改善す: Indeed. Factually speaking, they are underperforming and struggling to grow. If you can improve their results, you will prove your usefulness.
どのチームを選ぶかはあなたの自由です。\nさて、どうしますか？: Which team you choose is up to you. Now then, what will you do?
